Commentary.Commentary: We are back for Pakistan's reply. Imam-ul-Haq and Fakhar Zaman are out to bat for the hosts while Adam Milne will bowl for the visitors.
... The Run Chase ...

The bowling from the hosts was really good as they came back brilliantly in the death over to pin the Kiwis on their backfoot and they held onto tight lines and lengths specially Naseem Shah who was finally rewarded with a couple in his last over. Shaheen Afridi and Haris Rauf took a couple too, while Shadab Khan chipped in with one. Although, Pakistan would be extremely disappointed with the way they fielded. There were plenty of misfields which allowed the Kiwis batters to turn their one into twos. Pakistan will be hoping that this does not have an impact later on. So then, the target is not a big one as the pitch looks like a belter for the batters. Pakistan would be delighted to head back out on the track. Will the hosts be able to take an early lead in this series? We shall find out soon. Do join us for the chase shortly...

We are at the halfway stage of this game as New Zealand has managed to score 288 runs for the loss of 7 wickets. The Kiwi innings started off in a slow manner but picked up pace in the later stage of the first powerplay. The wicket of Chad Bowes proved critical as they lost the momentum that was gained. Will Young and Daryl Mitchell then took the responsibility and batted really well together before the dismissal of Will Young on 86. Daryl Mitchell continued his strokeplay and ended up scoring a century. Daryl Mitchell was the top scorer for the team with a score of 113 to his name.

TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Pakistan. They will BOWL first.

New Zealand on the contrary would be buzzing at this point after levelling the T20I series in the final T20I. This would be a perfect test for the side ahead of the ICC World Cup 2023 as they would get a chance to explore ideas and find out who would be a perfect fit in the absence of Kane Williamson, if he doesn't recover in time for the big event. The standout batter who took the Pakistani bowling unit apart was Mark Chapman, but will any other batter put his hand up this time around for the Kiwis? We shall find out soon, as the series is about to get underway. Other than that their bowling has been a bit hot and cold but they do have some amazing firepower and would be relying on them to give them a lead in this series. Toss and team updates to follow.

Pakistan would be coming into this game a bit wounded with their defeat against the odds in the last and final T20I despite the squad being at full strength. The hosts would be itching to bounce back and start the ODI series with a bang and outclass the opponents. The batting unit looks solid as Babar Azam is leading the team with an exemplary scoring spree and he is well helped by the top and middle order as well. The bowling is what is a matter of concern for the hosts as they have failed to step up and compliment the batters and it could be a match-deciding factor in this game as well.
